abstracted_predicate.name: RESOLVES_OBSERVED_BLOCKING_FAILURE_VIA_DIAGNOSED_ALTERNATIVE_AND_CONFIRMATION
abstracted_predicate.definition: An observed failure, refusal, or blocking constraint is diagnosed by reasoning that identifies a cause or limiting condition and specifies a concrete alternative remedy; an action then implements that alternative rather than repeating the failed approach; and a later observation confirms that the obstacle has been overcome, consistent with the remedy having been applied.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The initial observation reporting an error, refusal, or blocking constraint that prevented an intended operation.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies a cause or limiting condition of the reported failure and specifies an alternative remedy distinct from the failed approach.

parameters.name: remediation_action
parameters.description: The action that executes the specified alternative remedy rather than repeating the failed approach.

parameters.name: confirmation_observation
parameters.description: The later observation reporting success or removal of the obstacle, consistent with the alternative remedy having been applied.

assertion_conditions: The failure observation reports an error, refusal, or blocking constraint that prevented an intended operation.
The diagnosis reasoning identifies a cause or limiting condition of that failure and specifies an alternative remedy that differs from the failed approach.
The remediation action executes the specified alternative remedy rather than repeating the failed approach.
The confirmation observation reports success or removal of the obstacle, consistent with the alternative remedy having been applied.
exclusion_conditions: No failure or blocking constraint is reported by the initial observation.
The reasoning notes the failure without diagnosing a cause or specifying an alternative remedy.
The action merely repeats the failed approach or does not implement the specified remedy.
The later observation still reports failure, or is unrelated to the obstacle.
No subsequent observation confirms resolution of the obstacle.
